about.dashboard: Greeting and a way into every area you can use.
about.modules: Modules installed on this server: permissions, events, jobs, migrations.

about.general: Plan, domains, partner connections, modules, jobs, webhooks and the audit log.

about.developers: Webhook deliveries, request log, events by record, OpenAPI document.
about.entries: Posts and pages: drafts, review, scheduling, translations, SEO.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with an account of the Autoxide server.
login.mfaDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
login.mfaExpired: The sign-in step expired. Sign in again.
login.unreachable: The Autoxide server does not answer. Try again in a moment.
login.deleted: Your account was deleted and you were signed out.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Modules installed in this server, in start order. Modules are compiled into the server: installing or removing one means rebuilding it.
modules.name: Name
modules.pendingHint: Run `autoxide migrate up` on the server to apply pending migrations.

errors.forbidden: Your account lacks the permission `{permission}`. Ask an administrator to give it to one of your roles.
errors.failed: The page could not be loaded. Try again; if it keeps failing, check that the Autoxide server is running.

form.fix: {count, plural, one {One field needs fixing.} other {# fields need fixing.}}

shell.home: Autoxide admin, go to the overview
shell.searchPlaceholder: Find a page or an area…
shell.noMatch: No page matches. Try the name of an area, such as "modules".

dashboard.description: Every area you can use on this server. Areas appear here once their module is installed and your role grants their permission.
dashboard.nothing: No area is available to you yet. Ask an administrator to add a role with the permissions you need.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your profile, how you sign in, the devices signed in to your account, and your data. You do all of this yourself; nobody has to approve it.

required.name: Give the passkey a name, up to 100 characters.
required.confirm_email: Type your email address to confirm.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: To change your display name, ask an administrator.
profile.unverifiedHint: Open the link in the verification mail to confirm this address.

email.sent: A verification mail is on its way to {email}.
email.changeIntro: The verification mail goes to the NEW address. Your email changes only when you open its link within 24 hours; until then the current address stays in use.

password.title: Password
password.meta: Changing it signs out every other device.
password.intro: Every other device is signed out; you stay signed in here. Several wrong current passwords lock sign-in for this email for a while.
password.done: Password changed. Other devices must sign in again.

totp.title: Two-step sign-in (authenticator app)
totp.onMeta: Sign-in asks for a code from your app. {remaining, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}.
totp.offMeta: Add a 6-digit code from an app such as an authenticator to every sign-in.
totp.lowCodes: {remaining, plural, =0 {No recovery code left.} one {Only # recovery code left.} other {Only # recovery codes left.}} Make new ones before you lose your phone.
totp.enableIntro: You will scan a code with your authenticator app, then type the code the app shows.
totp.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
totp.newCodesIntro: Ten new codes replace the old ones; the old ones stop working.
totp.codesReplaced: New recovery codes made; the old ones no longer work.
totp.disableIntro: Your remaining recovery codes are deleted. Signing in then needs only your password or a passkey.

codes.once: These codes are shown only this once. Each works once in place of a code from the app, for example after losing your phone. Store them somewhere safe, away from the phone.
codes.label: Recovery codes
codes.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying. Download the codes or write them down.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.about: A passkey signs you in with the fingerprint, face or PIN of a device, and cannot be phished like a password.
passkeys.addIntro: Your browser then asks for the fingerprint, face or PIN of this device, or of a security key.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: To recognize it later, for example "Work laptop".
passkeys.unsupported: This browser cannot create passkeys. Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
passkeys.cancelled: The passkey was not created: the request was cancelled or timed out.
passkeys.exists: This device already holds a passkey for your account.
passkeys.failed: The browser could not create the passkey. Try again.
passkeys.removeIntro: It stops working at once. Delete it from the device as well.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.about: See a device you do not know? Sign it out, then change your password.
sessions.ended: Signed out. That device must sign in again.
sessions.endOthersIntro: {count, plural, one {The other device} other {All # other devices}} must sign in again. You stay signed in here. A device signed out can keep working until its current access expires (15 minutes by default).
sessions.endedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other device was signed in.} one {Signed out # device.} other {Signed out # devices.}}
sessions.useSignOut: This is the session you are using. Sign out from the account menu instead.
sessions.unknownCurrent: This session is not recognized yet, so it cannot be marked or kept. Sign out and in again, or wait a few minutes.

data.title: My data
data.exportMeta: A JSON file with everything the server keeps about you: profile, roles, sessions, API keys, passkeys, two-step sign-in status, and what each module keeps. Passwords, tokens and keys are never in it.
data.deleteMeta: Deletes your account at once. This cannot be undone.
data.lastAdmin: If you are the last administrator, give the admin role to someone else before deleting your account.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.goesNow: removes your account, sessions, API keys and passkeys at once, and signs you out;
delete.goesLater: removes the data other modules keep for you (notes, files…) shortly after;
delete.mismatch: This is not your email. Type {email} exactly.

sample.badge: Sample data · waiting for API step {step}
sample.missing: Not in the core yet: {endpoint}. Changes here are kept in memory only and are lost when the app restarts.

codes.auth_invitation_invalid: This invitation was already used, revoked or has expired.
codes.auth_delegation_not_active: This delegation is no longer active.
codes.auth_support_grant_not_active: This grant is no longer in effect.
codes.plans_same_plan: This is already your plan and billing period.
codes.tenant_domain_taken: This domain already belongs to a customer.
codes.tenant_domain_not_found: This domain is not in your account.
codes.kernel_job_not_dead: Only a job in the dead-letter queue can be retried.
codes.kernel_approval_not_found: This approval request does not exist.
codes.kernel_approval_not_pending: This request was already decided or has expired.
codes.menus_key_taken: This website already has a menu with this key and language.

fields.unknown: Choose one of the listed values.
fields.past: Choose a date in the future.
fields.tax_code: Enter 10 digits, or 10 digits, a dash and 3 digits.
fields.domain: Enter a domain name such as shop.example.com (not an IP address or localhost).

sample.badgeNew: Sample data · waiting for a new API
sample.badgeModule: Sample data · waiting for the {module} module

access.crumb: Organization · accounts, roles, invitations, delegation, support access
access.title: Users and roles
access.description: Who can sign in and what each person may do. A role is a set of permissions; a person with several roles has every permission of all of them.

required.name: Enter a display name.
required.confirm_email: Type the email address to confirm.
required.display_name: Enter the name shown on the website.

create.title: New user
create.intro: The account starts without a role: give it roles on the next page. A mail asking to confirm the address goes to the new email.
create.name: Display name
create.passwordHint: 12 to 128 characters. Leave empty to let the person set it through a password-reset mail, or set a first password later.
create.done: User created. Give them roles below.

user.notFound: No user has this id. The account may have been deleted.
user.name: Display name

status.title: Status
status.activeHint: Can sign in and use the API.
status.disableNow: They are signed out everywhere and their access tokens stop working at once.
status.disableKeep: The account, its roles and its data stay; they cannot sign in until enabled again.
status.disableUndo: You can enable the account again at any time.
status.disabled: Account disabled; they were signed out everywhere.

roles.title: Roles
roles.about: Saving replaces every role of this person. Changes apply on their next request.
roles.everything: Every permission, including ones added later.

delete.title: Delete {who}?
delete.goesNow: The account and its sign-in methods are deleted now.
delete.goesLater: Data other modules keep for this person is deleted shortly after.
delete.noUndo: This cannot be undone. To only stop them from signing in, disable the account instead.
delete.meta: Removes the account and everything it owns. Needs every permission the person has.

admin.title: Administrator actions
admin.about: Actions on someone else's account. Check who is asking before using them.

reset.title: Send a password-reset mail
reset.meta: The person chooses a new password from the link (valid 30 minutes). Administrators cannot replace an existing password.
reset.sent: If the account is active, a reset mail is on its way to {email}.

password.meta: Only for an account created without a password.
password.title: First password for {who}
password.intro: Works only when the account has no password yet. To change an existing password, send a password-reset mail.
password.done: Password set; they can sign in with it.

sessions.meta: Ends every session of this person on every device.
sessions.title: Sign {who} out everywhere?
sessions.now: Every session ends; each device must sign in again.
sessions.tokens: An access token already issued keeps working until it expires (15 minutes by default).
sessions.keepOut: To keep them out for good, disable the account instead.
sessions.done: {count, plural, =0 {They had no session.} one {Ended # session.} other {Ended # sessions.}}

mfa.meta: For a person who lost the device with their authenticator app.
mfa.title: Turn off two-step sign-in for {who}?
mfa.effect: They sign in with the password alone, then can set up a new device.
mfa.check: Make sure the request really comes from them: anyone who knows the password can then sign in.
mfa.done: Two-step sign-in is off for this account.

roles.title: Roles
roles.about: Open a role to see and change its permissions. The built-in admin role grants every permission and cannot be changed.
roles.count: {count, plural, =0 {No permission} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}

role.notFound: No role has this id. It may have been deleted.
role.builtinNote: Built-in role: it grants every permission, including permissions added later by new modules. It cannot be changed or deleted, and at least one active user must keep it.
role.name: Name
role.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter. Example: editor.
role.findHint: Find by name or what it allows…
role.unknown: No longer offered by any module.
role.readOnly: You can see this role but not change it (needs auth.roles.manage).

delete.title: Delete the role {name}?
delete.holders: Everyone who has this role loses its permissions on their next request.

invitations.inviteIntro: The person gets a one-time link, valid 7 days. Without an account they set a password or add a passkey when accepting.
invitations.sent: Invitation sent; follow it in this list.
invitations.name: Name (optional)
invitations.depth: How far each permission reaches is set by the role, not here. You can only invite with roles whose permissions you hold at that unit.
invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.about: Pending, accepted, expired or revoked invitations. Needs auth.invitations.manage at the unit invited to.
invitations.resent: Sent again to {email}; the old link stopped working.
invitations.revokeLink: The link in the mail stops working at once.
invitations.revokeAgain: To invite them later, send a new invitation.

delegations.createIntro: Whoever holds this role at your root can work in the child customer with exactly those permissions. The child sees the delegation but cannot revoke it.
delegations.created: Delegated; the event is recorded at both customers.
delegations.expiresHint: Empty: no end date. Ends at the end of that day (UTC).
delegations.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters; both customers see it in their audit log.
delegations.title: Outgoing delegation
delegations.audit: Each time your staff enter a child customer through a delegation, the event is recorded there and copied back to you, so both sides can look it up.
delegations.revokeNow: Sessions opened through it lose their permissions on the next request.
delegations.revokeAudit: The revocation is recorded at both customers.

public.about: What the website shows about each store: name, address, opening hours, pickup. Only units marked public appear; members and internal settings never do.
public.readOnly: You can see these profiles but not change them (needs {permission}).
public.saved: Saved; the store page on the website updates in a few minutes.
public.isPublicHint: Off: the unit disappears from the list of stores.
public.provinceHint: Address follows the administrative units after the 2025 merger: province or city, then ward or commune (no district).
public.hoursHint: Same hours every day. Hours per day and special closing days need the API.
public.pickupHint: Buyers can choose this store at checkout.

support.isOn: Platform staff may enter to help when you report a problem.
support.isOff: Only requests from a competent authority (with a document number) can be granted.
support.revokeNote: Step 34 of the core only lets the platform operator revoke a grant. The Revoke button below follows the proposed API: you control the data, so you should be able to end access yourself.
support.revokeNow: Their support session loses its permissions on the next request.
support.revokeAudit: The revocation is recorded in your audit log.
support.saved: Saved; new grants follow this setting.
support.allow: Platform staff may enter when you report a problem
support.allowHint: Off: only requests from a competent authority (with a document number) can be granted, and those are still recorded here.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the mail again, or ask for a new mail.
verify.done: {email} is confirmed. If you asked to change your address, sign in with this one from now on.
verify.description: Confirm that this address belongs to you.
verify.invalidHint: Sign in and send a new verification mail from My account.

forgot.done: If an account has the address {email}, a mail with a link to choose a new password is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account; we send a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
reset.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
reset.description: The link from the mail works once, for 30 minutes.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Plan and subscription, domains, partner connections, modules, jobs, staff, webhooks and the audit log. Each section names the permission it needs.

required.url: Enter the address that receives events.
required.name: Give the key a name.
required.events: Choose at least one event, or every event.

secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

plan.title: Plan and subscription
plan.about: Plans are sold by the operator. See your usage, pay each period, change or cancel the plan. Needs plans.billing.read to view and plans.billing.manage to change.
plan.renewalOff: Will not renew at the end of the period
plan.dueCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to pay} one {# open period} other {# open periods}}
plan.scheduled: Changes to {plan} at the end of this period.
plan.cancelUntil: You keep the plan and every module until the end of the current period.
plan.cancelData: After that, creating new records is blocked; existing data is kept.
plan.cancelUndo: You can keep renewing any time before the period ends.
plan.monthly: Counted per month; resets on the first day of the next month.
plan.usageAbout: Limits count the whole account. Reaching a limit blocks creating new records; existing data stays.
plan.money: Subscription money does not go through your account. Paying opens the payment page of the operator's licensed partner; a period becomes paid only when the partner confirms it, and the invoice is issued by the invoices module.
plan.changeUp: A bigger plan takes effect now; the difference is billed for the rest of the period.
plan.changeDown: A smaller plan starts when the current period ends.

profile.title: Invoice details
profile.about: Used on every invoice for your subscription. Needs plans.billing.manage to change.
profile.taxCodeHint: 10 digits, or 10 digits, a dash and 3 digits for a branch.
profile.communeHint: From the administrative units list, which has effective dates.

domains.title: Domains
domains.about: Run your website on your own domain: add it, set a TXT record to prove you own it, then attach it to the unit that uses it. Needs kernel.domains.manage.
domains.txt: Add this TXT record at your DNS provider:
domains.verified: Checked. The result is in the list.
domains.revokeSite: The website stops answering on this domain at once.
domains.revokeAgain: To use it again, add it and verify it again.
domains.addIntro: After adding, set the TXT record shown in the list. The domain is checked every 10 minutes for 7 days.
domains.added: Domain added. Set its TXT record.

connections.agentNote: AI agents cannot write secrets: no MCP tool sets or reads them. Testing a connection, last use and last error need new API (listed in the API gaps).

ai.title: AI
ai.forbidden: You need the permission {permission} to see the AI status.
ai.absent: The AI module is not installed on this server.
ai.off: Off. Suggestions and translations are hidden.
ai.about: The server operator turns AI on with the AUTOXIDE_AI_* and AUTOXIDE_EMBEDDING_* settings. AI output is only ever a suggestion or a draft.

connections.title: Partner connections
connections.about: Connection details of your own partners. Without them, the server-wide configuration is used. Secrets are encrypted when saved and never shown again; to change one, enter a new value. Needs kernel.settings.manage.

hints.mail: Sends sign-in, invitation and notification emails.
hints.sms: Needed to verify phone numbers of people who post content. Without it, that feature is off.
hints.payment: A licensed partner collects buyers' money; it never goes to your account.
hints.einvoice: Issues e-invoices through a licensed provider.

connections.tested: Tested. The result is in the list.
connections.secretNote: Changing a secret does not interrupt anything: the new value is used from the next request. The history records the setting name and who changed it (event kernel.setting_changed), never the value.
connections.formIntro: Values are saved for this account only.
connections.secretKeep: Set. Leave empty to keep the current value.
connections.secretNew: Secret: stored encrypted, never shown again.

jobs.cliNote: Not in the API yet: the core has only the server command autoxide jobs for operators. The list per account, progress and retry with audit wait for step 52.
jobs.title: Recent jobs
jobs.about: Background work: exports, printing, sending invoices, image processing. See progress, errors and the dead-letter queue; a retry is written to the audit log.
jobs.retryFrom: The job runs again from the start, with its attempts counted again.
jobs.retryAudit: The retry is written to the audit log with your name.

webhooks.allEventsHint: Also events added later by new modules.
webhooks.chosen: {count, plural, =0 {none chosen} one {# chosen} other {# chosen}}
webhooks.addIntro: Every event it subscribes to is sent as a signed POST. Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds; other answers are retried for about two hours.
webhooks.secretOnce: Store this secret now: it is shown only once. Verify the webhook-signature header of each request with it (Standard Webhooks).
webhooks.urlHint: An https:// address, up to 2048 characters.
webhooks.descriptionHint: What the endpoint is for, up to 200 characters.
webhooks.rotateOld: The old secret stops working at once: requests signed with the new one fail at your receiver until you update it.
webhooks.rotateOnce: The new secret is shown only once.
webhooks.deleteStops: No more events are sent to this address; pending retries are dropped.
webhooks.title: Endpoints
webhooks.about: Send events to other systems (accounting, CRM). Each endpoint chooses its events and has its own signing secret. Needs webhooks.manage.
webhooks.disableStops: Events are no longer sent to it.
webhooks.disableBack: Turning it on again sends only new events.
webhooks.deliveriesAbout: Each event sent to this endpoint, with retries. Kept for 30 days.
webhooks.findHint: Find by name or what happened…

audit.kindNote: Filtering by AI agent or service needs API: the log tells only “user” and “system” apart; API key kinds (person / agent / service) come with step 51, and there is no filter by kind of actor yet.
audit.title: Log
audit.about: Who changed what, when, before and after. Needs audit.read.
audit.subject: Record

agent.crumb: Settings · machines and AI agents use Autoxide over REST and MCP, with exactly the permissions they are given
agent.title: API keys and AI agents
agent.description: An API key acts as you, limited to the permissions you choose. Risky commands called by an agent (refunds, payouts, deleting data) do not run at once: they wait for someone with the same permission to approve.

tabs.label: API keys and AI agents sections

apiKeys.title: Your API keys
apiKeys.about: Keys of your own account, for programs and AI agents. A key never has more than you have at the moment of the request.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.revoke401: Requests with this key get 401 at once.
apiKeys.revokeAgents: Agents and programs using it stop working until they get a new key.
apiKeys.kindNote: Key kinds (person, agent, service) and approval of risky agent commands come with step 51 of the core.
apiKeys.newAbout: Give the key only what its job needs. You can choose only permissions you have yourself.
apiKeys.keyOnce: Store this key now: it is shown only once. Send it in the Authorization header, after the word Bearer.
apiKeys.nameHint: What the key is for, e.g. nightly-report-agent.
apiKeys.expiryHint: A key that expires limits the damage if it leaks.
apiKeys.passwordHint: Creating a key is sensitive: a stolen session alone must not create a key that outlives it.

approvals.title: Commands waiting for approval
approvals.about: Risky commands an agent called. Only requests you can approve (you have the command's permission) are listed. They expire after 24 hours.
approvals.expiresIn: {hours, plural, =0 {Expires now} one {Expires in # hour} other {Expires in # hours}}
approvals.rejected: Rejected; the agent gets the reason over MCP.
approvals.approveRuns: {agent} runs {tool} with its original Idempotency-Key: the command runs exactly once.
approvals.approveAudit: You are recorded as the approver in the audit log.

calls.title: MCP tool calls
calls.about: Which tool an agent called, with which key, and how it ended. Arguments with personal data are not stored.

mcp.title: Connect an AI agent over MCP
mcp.about: AI agents call the same functions as the REST API, as tools, through the Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP).
mcp.endpointHint: The core address this admin uses. If the agent runs on another network, use the public address of the core with /mcp.
mcp.step1: Create an API key with only the permissions the agent needs.
mcp.step2: Add the endpoint to your agent and send the key in the Authorization header, after the word Bearer.
mcp.step3: The agent sees only the tools its key allows.
mcp.rulePermissions: Each tool needs the same permission as the matching REST endpoint.
mcp.ruleSame: Tools run the same code as REST: a tool can never do what the key could not do over REST.
mcp.ruleAudit: Writes made by tools land in the audit log with the key.

developers.title: Developers
developers.description: Webhook deliveries, request log and events by record. Request bodies, tokens and passwords are never stored.
developers.docsOff: The API docs page is off on this server (AUTOXIDE_HTTP_API_DOCS=true turns it on at /api/docs). The OpenAPI document is always available.
developers.deliveriesAbout: Recent deliveries of every endpoint, newest first.
developers.noEndpoints: No endpoints yet. Add one under Settings › Webhooks.
developers.resendNote: Resending one delivery needs API (step 52); deliveries are retried automatically for about two hours.
developers.requestsAbout: Route templates (no real ids), status, error code, time and API key. Kept for 14 days.
developers.eventsAbout: Pick a kind of record and its id to see every event about it, in order. Try {example}.

list.title: Posts
list.description: Every post and page of the website, drafts included. Open one to write, review, schedule or publish it.
list.noMatch: No post or page matches these filters.
list.empty: No posts or pages yet. Create the first one with "New post".

editor.linkInvalid: Use an address that starts with https://, http://, mailto: or / (a page of this site).
editor.linkHint: Links to javascript: and other unsafe addresses are refused by the server.
editor.embedHint: Only sites the server allows can be embedded (by default YouTube and Vimeo).
editor.conflict: Someone changed this entry after you opened it. Nothing was overwritten. Reload to see their version; your unsaved changes here will be lost, so copy any text you want to keep first.
editor.words: {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} · {minutes, plural, one {# min read} other {# min read}}
editor.title: Title
editor.excerptHint: Shown in lists, feeds and link previews.
editor.bodyHint: Saved as structured blocks, not HTML. The server checks every block and reports problems with their place.
editor.readOnly: You can read this entry but not change it: your role lacks content.write.
editor.imageAltHint: Describes the image in the language of this post; leave empty only for a decorative image.

panel.label: Entry settings
panel.unpublished: Taken down: readers no longer see it
panel.viaApiKey: with an API key (machine or AI agent)
panel.schedulePinned: A scheduled publish keeps the draft as it was when scheduled; later edits are not published by it.
panel.slugHint: Changing it after publishing makes the old address redirect (301) to the new one. Leave it empty to make one from the title.
panel.aiNote: AI only suggests or writes drafts; it never publishes. Readers are told when content was made with AI.
panel.unpublishIntro: Readers stop seeing it at once and its address answers 404. It becomes a draft again and can be published later. A pending scheduled publish is canceled.
panel.archiveIntro: It is taken down for good: its address answers 410 (gone) so search engines drop it, and every pending schedule is canceled. It can still be published again later.
panel.archiveDraftIntro: The draft is put away: it leaves the drafts list and every pending schedule is canceled. It can still be published later.
panel.noAuthors: No author profiles yet. Someone with content.manage creates them.
panel.authorsHint: In the order you tick them; the first is the main author. Takes effect at once, also on the published version.
panel.noTerms: No categories or tags yet. Someone with content.manage creates them.
panel.termsHint: The first category ticked is the main one. Takes effect at once, also on the published version.
panel.featuredHint: Shown on lists and at the top of the post. Published posts need public images.

seo.checkUnavailable: The check could not be run.
seo.checkSaved: The check reads the saved draft: save to check your latest changes.
seo.canonicalHint: Only when the content first appeared on another site; leave empty otherwise.
seo.noindex: Ask search engines not to index it
seo.noindexHint: noindex: the page stays reachable but is left out of search results.
seo.suggestHint: Uses AI tokens. Nothing is changed until you apply it; applying marks the entry as AI-assisted.
seo.aiForbidden: Unavailable: your role cannot see whether AI is on (ai.view).
seo.aiOff: AI is off on this server. The operator turns it on with the AUTOXIDE_AI_* settings.

codes.excerptMissing: No summary: lists, feeds and link previews have nothing to show.
codes.headingSkipped: A heading level is skipped (for example heading 2 then heading 4).
codes.imageAltMissing: An image has no text alternative.
codes.metaDescriptionMissing: No search description: search engines pick a sentence themselves.
codes.metaDescriptionTooLong: The search description is too long; search engines cut it.
codes.metaTitleMissing: No search title: the title is used.
codes.metaTitleTooLong: The search title is too long; search engines cut it.
codes.noindexPublished: It is published but asks search engines not to index it.
codes.shareImageMissing: No image for social sharing (and no main image to fall back on).
codes.titleDuplicate: Another entry in this language has the same title.

seo.shareImageHint: Shown when the link is shared on social networks; empty: the featured image.

languages.outdated: Translation is out of date: the original changed
languages.aiOff: Translating with AI needs AI turned on on this server.
languages.queued: Translation started; it appears as a draft when done
languages.note: Each translation is its own entry: own address, status, schedule and history. A missing translation is never replaced by another language.

history.restoreIntro: Its title, text, summary and SEO fields are copied into the draft. Nothing is published; categories, tags and authors stay as they are.
history.note: The server keeps a revision on creation, on each publish and take-down, on restore, and when the last one is more than 10 minutes old.

publish.intro: Readers will see the draft as it is now, at {path}.
publish.introPage: Readers will see the draft as it is now, under its parent page.
publish.savesFirst: Your unsaved changes are saved first.
publish.nothingNew: The published version already matches the draft.
publish.seoErrors: The SEO check found problems to fix. You can still publish.
publish.reviewRequired: Confirm that you read and reviewed the parts written by AI.
publish.whenInvalid: Pick a date and time in the future.
publish.laterHint: The draft as it is now is published at that time, even if you edit it later.
publish.aiReviewed: I read and reviewed the parts made with AI
publish.aiReviewedHint: The published version records who reviewed it and when; the website can show readers that AI helped.
publish.permission: Needs content.publish. Each publish keeps a revision and is recorded in the audit log.
publish.scheduleUnpublishIntro: The entry is taken down at that time (its address answers 404).

preview.title: Preview the draft
preview.intro: Anyone with the link can read the saved draft, without an account, until the link expires (10 minutes by default).
preview.savesFirst: Your unsaved changes are saved first.
preview.banner: Draft preview — readers do not see this version.
preview.aiNotice: Made with the help of AI.
preview.invalid: This preview link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

new.description: Write a first draft. Nothing is published until you publish it.
new.localeHint: Other languages are added later as translations.
new.slugHint: Optional: made from the title when empty.
new.draftNote: SEO, authors, categories, preview and publishing are in the editor once the draft is created.

sample.sitesNote: Each domain is a website owned by an organization unit. Posts are not tied to a website yet: the list shows every post.
sample.requiredSales: An online shop must publish these pages before notifying the Ministry of Industry and Trade (Decree 52/2013, amended by Decree 85/2021; check the original text).
sample.requiredPlatform: A marketplace also needs its operating rules, a contract template for sellers and seller information on product pages before registering.
sample.drafted: Draft created from the template; fill in your details, then publish
sample.owner: Owned by {owner}: people there and in parent units can edit it.

media.crumb: Content · shared by posts, pages and products
media.title: Media library
media.summary: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}{more, select, more { on this page} other {}} · {size} · {noAlt, plural, =0 {every image has alt text} one {# image without alt text} other {# images without alt text}}
media.emptyHint: Try another folder or remove some filters.
media.noAltPageNote: “Missing alt” filters the files of this page only; open the next page to see more.
media.trashNote: Files in the trash stop loading on the website. Restore them, or delete them for good; the server deletes them by itself after the number of days it keeps them.

upload.dropTitle: Drop files here, or press Upload
upload.dropRoot: Into the root folder. New files are private. The server checks the real type from the content.
upload.dropInto: Into the folder {folder}. New files are private. The server checks the real type from the content.
upload.duplicates: {count, plural, one {# file in the library has the same content.} other {# files in the library have the same content.}}

codes.tooLarge: The file is larger than the server accepts.
codes.typeNotAllowed: The server does not accept this type of file.
codes.contentMismatch: The content of the file is not of the type it claims.
codes.unknownType: The type of the file could not be detected.
codes.svgActive: The SVG contains scripts or links that can run; it is refused.
codes.invalidType: The type of the file is not a media type.
codes.interrupted: The upload was cut off. Try again.
codes.conflict: Someone changed this file meanwhile. Reload it and try again.
codes.other: The file could not be uploaded.

folders.label: Folders
folders.newIntro: Created inside the folder you have open.
folders.name: Name
folders.nameRequired: Enter a name for the folder.
folders.deleteEmpty: Only an empty folder can be deleted: files in the trash count too.
folders.deleteKeep: Its files are not affected; move or delete them first.

detail.title: File details
detail.gone: This file is no longer in the library.
detail.conflict: Someone changed this file since you opened it. Reload to see their change, then try again.
detail.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas; at most 20.
detail.altHint: Describes the image for screen readers and search engines, one sentence per language. Leave it empty only for a decorative image.
detail.aiFresh: Suggested by AI · edit if needed; saved only when you press Save alt text
detail.aiDecorative: AI thinks the image is decorative: leave its alt text empty.
detail.aiOff: AI suggestions are off on this server.
detail.aiForbidden: You may not use AI (permission ai.view).
detail.aiNoImages: The AI model of this server does not read images.
detail.aiUnsupported: AI reads JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP images only.
detail.decorativeHint: Adds no information; its alt text stays empty.
detail.name: File name
detail.caption: Caption
detail.variantsPending: Smaller copies are made in the background a few seconds after an upload.
detail.variantsNone: This type of file gets no smaller copies.
detail.urlPublic: Public: anyone can load it from this address on the server; with v it may be cached for a year.
detail.urlPrivate: Private: only signed-in people with media.read can load it. Published posts need public images.
detail.usageMissing: The server cannot list yet where a file is used. Check the posts that show it before moving it to the trash.
detail.replaced: Content replaced; every place using the file shows the new one
detail.trashLink: Its public address stops working at once.
detail.trashUsage: Posts and pages that show it lose the image.
detail.trashRestore: You can restore it from the trash until the server deletes it.
detail.purgeForever: The content is deleted and cannot be brought back.
detail.purgeUsage: Places still pointing to it will show nothing.

picker.altHint: In the language of this post. Starts from the alt text of the file.
picker.aiFresh: Suggested by AI: check it before you use it.
picker.aiDecorative: AI thinks the image is decorative: leave its alt text empty.
picker.caption: Caption
picker.makePublicHint: A published post can only show public images. Private images load for signed-in people only.

field.privateHint: Make it public in the media library before publishing.
field.altHint: In the language of this post.
field.unavailable: The media library is not available to you.

structure.title: Pages and structure
structure.description: Pages in a parent–child tree, categories and tags, authors, redirects when addresses change, and revision history.
structure.conflict: Someone changed this since the page was loaded. Reload the page and try again.

required.name: Enter a name.
required.authorName: Enter the name shown to readers.
required.fromPath: Enter the old address, starting with /.

pages.title: Page tree
pages.about: A page can sit under another page; its address follows the tree (for example /about-us/stores). Moving a page changes the address of its whole subtree, and the server makes redirects from the old addresses.
pages.more: Only the first 200 pages are shown.
pages.moveIntro: Choose a new parent page in the same language. The address of this page and of its subpages changes; old addresses redirect to the new ones.

terms.intro: Each language has its own name and slug. Choose the language, then fill them in.
terms.localeHint: Pick another language to add or change its name.
terms.name: Name
terms.deletePosts: Posts lose this category or tag; the posts stay.
terms.deleteChildren: A category with subcategories cannot be deleted; move them first.
terms.countMissing: The number of posts per category or tag is not shown yet: the server does not count them.

authors.title: Author profiles
authors.about: Authors are public profiles of the content module, separate from sign-in accounts. A post can have several authors (set them in the editor).
authors.intro: Shown to readers on posts and on the author page.
authors.name: Display name
authors.slugHint: Empty: made from the name. Used in the author page address.
authors.deletePosts: Posts no longer show this author; the posts stay.
authors.deletePage: The public author page stops working.
authors.countMissing: The number of posts per author is not shown yet: the server does not count them.

menus.title: Menus of the content module
menus.moved: Website menus moved to their own module, because a menu points to records of every module (posts, product categories, promotions, stores). The old menu API of Content keeps working until its sunset date; here it is read-only, as the source for “Import old menus”.
menus.unavailable: The old menus cannot be read (permission content.read).

redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.about: When a public address changes, the server makes a 301 redirect from the old one by itself. Content taken down for good answers 410 so search engines drop it.
redirects.intro: Readers and search engines opening the old address are sent to the new one.
redirects.fromHint: A path on this website, starting with /.

targetsHint.url: A path on this website (/…) or an https:// address.
targetsHint.entry: Follows the post even when its address changes later.
targetsHint.gone: Tells search engines the content was removed for good.

redirects.deleteOld: The old address stops redirecting and shows “not found”.
redirects.deleteSearch: Search engines may keep sending readers there for a while.

history.title: Revision history
history.about: The server keeps a version at each explicit save, publish, take-down, restore, and every 10 minutes of editing. Restoring a version makes it the draft; the published version does not change until you publish again.
history.gone: This post or page no longer exists.
history.sameVersion: Choose two different versions to compare.
history.diffUnavailable: The versions could not be read.
history.restoreIntro: The draft is replaced by this version. The published version does not change until you publish again; the history keeps every version.
history.conflict: The post changed since this page was loaded. Reload and try again.

diff.againstDraft: Compared with the saved draft (changes not saved yet are not included).
diff.identical: The two versions are the same.
diff.gap: {count, plural, one {# unchanged block} other {# unchanged blocks}}

menus.title: Website menus
menus.description: Build the category bar, mega menu, footer and account menu of each website, per language. Menu items can point to posts, categories, promotions, sellers and stores.
menus.fallback: When a language has no menu of its own, the storefront uses the menu of the default language.
menus.empty: This website has no menus yet.
menus.deleteStore: The storefront stops showing it (or falls back to the default language).
menus.deleteOther: Menus of other languages and websites are not touched.
menus.pick: Choose a menu above to edit it.

import.title: Moving from the old menus of Content
import.about: Menus are now a module of their own. The two old endpoints keep working until the sunset date, answering with Deprecation and Sunset headers that point to the new ones.
import.rules: Running the import again does not duplicate: each new item remembers the old item id. A menu that already exists in the new module is kept, never overwritten. Items pointing to a post become content.entry, to a category or tag content.term; addresses stay addresses.
import.unavailable: The old menus cannot be read (permission content.read).
import.none: There are no old menus to import.
import.done: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing new to import} one {# menu imported} other {# menus imported}}

create.title: New menu
create.intro: A menu belongs to the website you have chosen, in one language.
create.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits, - or _: main, footer, account…
create.keyRequired: Enter a key for the menu.
create.copyHint: Copying keeps the items and their targets; change the labels for the new language.

editor.simulateHint: Sample data only: saves a change as another person, to see what happens when two people edit at once.
editor.simulated: Someone else saved version {version}. Save now to see the conflict.
editor.saved: Saved version {version}. The storefront gets it when its cache expires (at most 60 seconds).
editor.conflictTitle: Someone else saved this menu meanwhile.
editor.conflictText: Your version was based on an older one, so nothing was saved (412, If-Match does not match). Your changes are still on this screen.
editor.localIssues: {count, plural, one {# item needs fixing before saving:} other {# items need fixing before saving:}}
editor.serverIssues: {count, plural, one {The server refused # item:} other {The server refused # items:}}
editor.treeHint: Choose an item, then move it up or down, out or in, add a sub-item or remove it.
editor.empty: This menu has no items. Press “Add item” to start.
editor.added: Item added; set its target and label on the right
editor.tooMany: A menu has at most {max} items.

move.edge: It cannot move further that way.
move.depth: A menu has at most {max} levels.
move.noSibling: Indenting needs an item at the same level right above.

editor.choose: Choose an item in the tree to edit it.

url.label: Address
url.ok: https://, mailto: or a path on this website (/…).
url.protocolRelative: //host is not accepted because browsers guess the protocol; write https://host in full.
url.insecure: Only https:// is accepted, not http://.
url.unsupported: An address starts with https://, mailto: or /.

editor.kindStep: The records registry is waiting for core step {step}.
editor.refHint: The item keeps only the kind and id: when the record is renamed or moves, the menu follows. When the record stops being public, the storefront drops the item and its sub-items.
editor.groupHint: A group heading has no target: in the mega menu it becomes a column with its sub-items below; in the footer it is a column title.
editor.label: Label
editor.labelFromObject: Empty: the title of the record is used, and follows when it is renamed.
editor.labelRequired: Enter a label for this item.
editor.refRequired: Choose the record this item points to.
editor.autoHint: The storefront lists the sub-groups of this category, up to the number you set.
editor.autoUnsupported: Only for records that have a tree (categories).
editor.badgeOff: The badge does not show today (outside its dates).
editor.highlightHint: A top-level item with a highlight moves to the right of the category bar, in its colour.
editor.feature: Featured box in the mega menu
editor.featureHint: Shown on the right of the mega menu: the storefront takes the title, summary and image of the record; it hides itself when the record stops being public.

codes.menus_ref_unknown_kind: The kind {detail} is not registered. Turn on its module or change the target.
codes.menus_ref_not_found: The record {detail} does not exist (it may have been deleted).
codes.menus_children_unsupported: The kind {detail} has no sub-groups. Turn off “Fill sub-groups by itself”.
codes.menus_too_deep: A menu has at most 4 levels.
codes.menus_too_many_items: A menu has at most 200 items.

preview.title: Storefront preview
preview.about: Built from the unsaved draft, like the storefront. The “Best sellers” block is fetched by the storefront from the product list when the mega menu opens; it is not stored in the menu.
preview.hidden: {count, plural, one {# item points to a record that is not public: it will not show.} other {# items point to records that are not public: they will not show.}}
preview.tap: Press an item of the bar to open its mega menu.
preview.noMega: This item has no mega menu.
